lines.text: Many learners say: I have much friends.
Use many with things you can count.

data.why: Use many with things you can count.

native.tip: En español “muchos” vale para todo, pero en inglés “many” es para lo contable.
native.caption: “Muchos amigos”: ¡cuidado con “much”! 👫 Di “I have many friends.”, no “I have much friends.”. ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “many”. “Many” + contables; “much” + incontables. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: In Spanish “muchos” works for everything, but in English “many” is for countable things.
en.caption: “Muchos amigos”: careful with “much”! Say “I have many friends.”, not “I have much friends.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
